## What you should find {.scrollable}

| | OLS, all 56 | ridge | lasso | elastic net |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| predictors kept (all rows) | 56 | 56 | 34 | 46 |
| test RMSE (held-out 30%) | 1.631 | 1.606 | 1.596 | **1.595** |

::: {.check}
**OLS:** a host 1% larger holds about 0.5% more FDI, and a partner 1% farther away about 0.5% less,
holding the other fixed. Host size alone explains 5% of the variation.
:::

::: {.warn}
**The penalties gain little here:** 765 pairs for 56 candidates is not a square table. The elastic
net keeps 46 where the lasso keeps 34, because it lets correlated candidates in together.
:::

## What it does not license {.scrollable}

::: {.tight}
- **No causal claim.** A kept variable predicts FDI here; changing it need not attract any.
- **No "no effect"** for a zeroed candidate: among correlated ones, the lasso keeps one almost at random.
- **No p-values after selection**, and no claim beyond 765 data-rich, mostly OECD pairs.
:::
